newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Forint ends down vs dollar after U.S. GDP data.
newsitem.headline: Forint ends down vs dollar after U.S. GDP data.

text.p: The Hungarian forint closed weaker against the dollar on Wednesday as the U.S. unit jumped on GDP data, traders said.
"The forint traded around 182.20 to the U.S. unit then the dollar jumped on GDP figures to about 182.50," said Gabor Butor of Raiffeisen-Unicbank.
The forint closed at 182.50/55 against the dollar compared with an opening of 182.00 and a midday break value of 182.21/26.
The forint floats against the National Bank of Hungary's currency basket made up 30 percent of the dollar and 70 percent of the mark.
Due to May Day public holidays, the next market day in Hungary will be Monday, May 5.
